name: mirage
text: Checked against a second, independent set: PropLine's Pinnacle closes and real results on 2,676 +EV bets the engine saw. It mostly agrees with what I changed. Props, team totals and NHL beat the close the most. Edge of 2-6% beats 0-2%. Bets earlier than 24 hours out beat the close less. Bets priced by 1 book lost -21% and 2 books -12%, while 3 or more books were about even, so the small-book cap holds up. More agreement means better results (-17% at half or fewer books agreeing, -3% to -4% at 75% or more). Two things disagree, so I kept those effects small: bets inside 1 hour beat the close most but lost money, and game-total overs lost here while your own history had them winning. Both look like noise. Details are in research/star_rating_2026-10-23.md.
